judgement.reason: Focalboard supports PostgreSQL via config and file storage can be moved to S3, so the contained-change outcome is correct.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /opt/focalboard/data (docker/Dockerfile), volume fbdata:/opt/focalboard/data (docker/docker-compose.yml app)
reviews.reason: The image creates /opt/focalboard/data/files for uploaded files and declares it as a volume, and no shown setting moves those files to S3 or the database to managed storage, so the finding is not proven wrong.
